tasks.title: Equal-weight marginal (Type III) tests in an unbalanced two-factor design
tasks.source_relation: adapted: new fixtures, function-style contract, independent cell-means oracle
tasks.difficulty_hypothesis: The default aov/anova table is sequential (Type I) and silently answers different hypotheses in an unbalanced design; drop1() on a default treatment-coded fit answers yet another question when an interaction is present; ordered factors switch to polynomial contrasts; and car::Anova, the usual shortcut, is not installed.

mcp_relevance.rationale: The task is statistical reasoning about hypotheses and contrast coding. The decisive facts (how contr.sum, drop1 scope and sequential SS behave) are in base R documentation that is also installed locally; no package version or ecosystem fact changes the answer.
